Stellar TimeLock

The official F-Droid repository of the Stellar TimeLock wallet, signed with the project's own key. Source available at https://github.com/stellartimelock/stellartimelock-wallet

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://stellartimelock.com/fdroid/repo

If you would like to manually verify the fingerprint (SHA-256) of the repository signing key, here it is:
